RCVAccession.Title: NM_134269.3(SMTN):c.1924C>T (p.Arg642Cys) AND Clear cell carcinoma of kidney

Name.ElementValue: Renal cell carcinoma, clear cell, somatic

Citation.CitationText: Technology Assessment on Genetic Testing or Molecular Pathology Testing of Cancers with Unknown Primary Site to Determine Origin (ARCHIVED)
NCCN Clinical Practice Guidelines in Oncology (NCCN Guidelines®) Cervical Cancer, 2024

AttributeSet.Attribute: CEBPA-associated familial acute myeloid leukemia (AML) is typically characterized by earlier-onset disease compared to sporadic AML. Age of onset varies from 1.8 to 60 years, with younger onset in those with germline N-terminal CEBPA pathogenic variants. The prognosis appears to be favorable for AML associated with germline N-terminal CEBPA pathogenic variants compared to AML due to sporadic CEBPA pathogenic variants. However, individuals who have been cured of their initial disease are at greater risk of developing new, independent leukemic episodes, in addition to the risk of relapse from preexisting clones. Emerging data suggest that germline CEBPA pathogenic variants located downstream of the p30 start codon (residue 120) are often less penetrant but are associated with inferior clinical outcomes and shorter overall survival compared to AML due to germline N-terminal CEBPA pathogenic variants.

ClinVarAccession.SubmitterName: Dr. Peter K. Rogan Lab, Western University

Method.Description: In the sample (TCGA-B8-A8YJ), the counts of splice junction spanning reads and abundance of the transcript adjacent to this mutation were compared with RNASeq data from matched tissues and tumors lacking the same mutation using Veridical (PMID:24741438)

FunctionalData.FunctionalConsequenceComment: Modifies an exonic cryptic donor site at NC_000022.10:g.31492780 from -4.72 to 2.31 bits. Significant p-values: junction spanning - intron inclusion (4 reads, p=0.0028), read abundance - intron inclusion (8 reads, p=0.0001). Computations were originally performed using genomic coordinates. This variant was mapped to an appropriate current MANE database designation or, if not present in this source, to the longest relevant transcript in the Biocommons Universal Transcript Archive using the hgvs Python package. The original genomic coordinate was based on GRCh37 and was submitted as an "Alternate designation". Modifications of Figure 2 of PMID:31275557 for ClinVar: a) "strongly corroborating Veridical p-value" refers to "junction-spanning" evidence types; b) add the text "and natural site < 300 nucleotides away?" to "Ri,final > nearest natural site Ri"; c) "Aberrant" and "Likely aberrant" classifications are now both defined as "Functionally abnormal" (analogous to ACMG/AMP reporting); d) "Allele-specific alternative splicing" classification now defined as "Function uncertain" (based on results for similar variants in PMID: 32211018); e) average heterozygosity based-criteria no longer contribute to classification.
FunctionalData.Result: junction spanning - intron inclusion (p=0.0028),read abundance - intron inclusion (p=0.0001)
